articles.headline: Mexico's World Cup knockout 'hurts deeply,' says captain Edson Álvarez
articles.description: Mexico captain Edson Álvarez has admitted his country's elimination from the World Cup "hurts deeply" but is upbeat about the team's future.

articles.headline: Brazil's Football Confederation set to keep faith in Carlo Ancelotti despite World Cup exit to Norway
articles.description: Brazil's early elimination from the World Cup will not change the country's Football Confederation's plans to continue with coach Carlo Ancelotti.

articles.headline: Aguirre proud of Mexico squad despite World Cup heartbreak
articles.description: Aguirre proud of Mexico squad despite World Cup heartbreak

articles.headline: Two things can be true about Balogun's World Cup reprieve
articles.description: For USMNT fans, seeing Folarin Balogun play against Belgium after FIFA rescinded his suspension will feel a bit odd -- a jumble of joy tinged with a heavy slice of unease.

articles.headline: UEFA says FIFA 'crossed a red line' with Folarin Balogun red card ban U-turn
articles.description: UEFA have strongly criticised FIFA's decision to suspend USMNT striker Folarin Balogun's red card, thus allowing the United States striker to be available for the World Cup round-of-16 match against Belgium.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Harry Kane loses voice in hilarious interview, USMNT prepares for Belgium
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the World Cup as Portugal face Spain and the USMNT take on Belgium.
